name: NS Remove Related Products for WooCommerce
author: NsThemes

sections.description:
Take control of your WooCommerce product pages — for free.

Related products can be a great sales tool, but not always. Sometimes they distract customers, clutter your product pages, or simply don’t fit your store’s strategy. NS Remove Related Products lets you remove them instantly, with zero configuration and zero coding required. Install, activate, done.

This free version is already used by thousands of WooCommerce stores around the world and does exactly what it promises: removes the related products section from your single product pages cleanly and reliably, without conflicts or slowdowns.

Need more control? Upgrade to Premium.

The free version is the perfect starting point. But if you want to go further and turn the related products section into a real strategic asset for your store, the Premium version gives you everything you need:

  • Enable / Disable the plugin with a single click, without deactivating it
  • Audience targeting — show related products to all visitors, to registered users only, or hide them entirely
  • Per-product override — set a custom rule directly on individual product pages
  • Number of products — choose exactly how many related products to display
  • Order By — sort by date, title, random order, and more
  • Ascending / Descending — full control over sorting direction

Discover the Premium version →

Compatibility

We continuously test our plugins for compatibility with the most popular WordPress themes and plugins. If you find an incompatibility with a specific plugin or theme, please let us know at report@nsthemes.com and we will look into it as quickly as possible.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire ‘ns-remove-related-product-for-woocommerce’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Code is required to use this plugin?

No code required to use this plugin.

Is required WooCommerce to use this plugin?

Yes WooCommerce is required to use this plugin.
